PR: Allow empty services [closed; labels kind/enhancement, priority/P2, size/L, area/provider/nomad]
### What does this PR do?

This enables the nomad provider the ability to allow empty services. For instance, when a service is scaled down to 0 the route will persist. This would be an opt-in feature (false by default).
Fixes https://github.com/traefik/traefik/issues/10374

### Motivation

I currently have services in Nomad that scaled down to zero and use a port-knocking solution that scales the service up when the route receives traffic. Also, the Kubernetes provider already has [this

option](https://github.com/traefik/traefik/pull/8802), so I felt like it was missing from the nomad provider.

### More

- [x] Added/updated tests
- [x] Added/updated documentation

### Additional Notes

I attempted to implement this just like the Kubernetes provider for consistency.
